query:
select p.user_id,
                  count(*) as "votes_cast!",
                  count(*) filter (where p.vetoed) as "veto_count!",
                  avg((p.ballot ->> 'value')::float8) as average
           from poll_participants p join polls o on o.id = p.poll_id
           where o.status = 'closed' and o.kind = 'score' and p.ballot is not null
             and p.user_id = any($1)
           group by p.user_id
